title: Codify quality network and per-standard judge nodes

output.summary: Approve the quality-network framing: source graphs remain the frozen representation, but product semantics are layered quality networks. Non-deterministic standards are specialized judge nodes with one rubric and one 0-100 score per standard; batching remains only a transport optimization. No separate debug agent is needed because the coding agent uses the final report as the next loop worklist.

approvedRows.desiredState: CodeWiki quality standards form an interpretable network with deterministic and non-deterministic nodes, per-standard judge specs, numeric node scores, fail-fast hard gates, and high-signal final reports for the coding agent AX. Lab trains and tunes the network; the extension ships frozen production networks.
